323-4279-4314--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
323-4279-4314--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2438-3263-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
2438-3263-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat from step 3.
2438-3263-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

2866-4211-4247-4986.description:
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

240-1251-5470-6495.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-1251-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

728-4364-7917.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
728-4364-7917.description:
Declare Aurelia and Seluma as attackers. Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Aurelia.
Deal combat damage using Seluma. Seluma triggers, returning Aurelia from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2393-2738-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Sifter of Skulls, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2557-3129-4826-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-6913-7936.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-6913-7936.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Chameleon and Dominion Saboteur each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-6913-7936.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2793-3743-5089-7178-7824.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-5089-7178-7824.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

1203-3901.easyPrerequisites: You have more life than an opponent.
1203-3901.description:
Cast Fire Covenant by {1}{B}{R} and paying an amount of life equal to an opponent's life total, dealing that much damage to Wrathful Red Dragon.
Wrathful Red Dragon triggers, dealing that much damage to the opponent.

876-6478-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness X or greater.
876-6478-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Arbor Adherent.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Arbor Adherent.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Arbor Adherent.
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Arbor Adherent.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Arbor Adherent.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Arbor Adherent from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1368-5434-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-5434-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3532-5060-5078-7736.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
3532-5060-5078-7736.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

57-2751-4742-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-2751-4742-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2438-4681-5170-6094.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4676-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Elegant Edgecrafters.
When Elegant Edgecrafters dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Elegant Edgecrafters enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4475-6765.easyPrerequisites: A nonland permanent has left the battlefield this turn, or a spell has been warped this turn.
4475-6765.description:
Declare Alpharael as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing the defending player to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing the opponent to lose the remainder of their life total.

224-433-1174.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control a mana-producing land.
224-433-1174.notablePrerequisites: Llanowar Scout does not have summoning sickness.
224-433-1174.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Activate the land and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping another land.
Repeat.

4871-5315-6291.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

3484-4251-4636-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Godo that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste.
Put the oldest Godo into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Godo token enters the battlefield, its first ability, Gonti's Aether Heart and Decoction Module trigger.
Resolve the Godo trigger, searching your library for an Equipment and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Declare the Godo token as an attacker. The token triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1818-2034-4417-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher does not have a counter on it.
1818-2034-4417-5944.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher, adding {C}{C}.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
When Unstoppable Slasher enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {2} and 2 life, removing both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher and giving Hex Parasite +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1350-2557-5287.notablePrerequisites: Dihada has at least four loyalty counters on it.
1350-2557-5287.description:
Activate Dihada's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to reveal the top four cards of your library and put them into your graveyard, and create eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{W}{W}{B}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Dihada from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Dihada by paying {1}{R}{W}{B}.
Repeat.

513-3771.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast by paying {0} due to Animar.
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast by paying at most {1} due to Animar.
513-3771.description:
Cast any creature card by paying {0} due to Animar.
Animar and Hullbreaker Horror triggers.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hullbreaker Horror trigger, returning another creature that can be cast by paying {0} due to Animar from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Repeat.

2626-4809-4986.description:
Cast Shifting Wall by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Shifting Wall enters and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Shifting Wall from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

957-4050-4125-4935.manaNeeded: {8}{U} each odd-numbered turn, with {3}{U}{U} available each even-numbered turn
957-4050-4125-4935.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Shipwreck Dowser, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Conduit of Worlds by tapping it, causing you to pay {3}{U}{U} to cast Shipwreck Dowser from your graveyard.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

1912-2457-4474-5153.notablePrerequisites:
Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Sunstrike Legionnaire.
1912-2457-4474-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {G}.
Pay {G} to create a 1/1 Insect token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
